title: Building the Cairn

readiness.reading: pre-reader friendly; all text can be read aloud

intro.speaker: silas
intro.text: Up here, the mist can come down fast. Walkers find their way by the cairns: little heaps of stones along the trail.

intro.speaker: silas
intro.text: Let's mark the trail with a row of stones, in a pattern anyone can follow.

steps.speaker: silas
steps.prompt: Carry on the pattern of stones. What comes next?

older.prompt: Carry on the pattern: big, small, small. What comes next?

feedback.all_good: Now no one will lose the way, even in the mist.

outro.speaker: silas
outro.text: A good shepherd marks the way for those who come after. Thank you!

journal_line: In the mountains, I marked the trail with Mr. Silas's stones.
unavailable_text: The trail is marked for today.
